New Item: Core
Core Equipment System Cores are equipment items that can increase character stats when equipped.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/f989cc4d561ff9859fa8e703774d440105c597cf.png"]

You can obtain Tempest Cores that unlock Offensive stats and Halcyon Cores that unlock defensive stats through Core Fragments.

You can craft Awaken Stones, craft cores, and dismantle cores through the \[Inventory (F2) - Core Management] UI.

【Awaken Stone Crafting】

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/ff998f7d69251a929de65beff901ad93f84ac2d9.png"]

You can craft Awaken Stones by clicking the \[Lv.540] Awaken Stone item in the \[Core Management - Awakening Materials] tab.

crafting 1 Awakening Stone requires a total of 2,000 points, with each material providing different point increases.

When crafting Awaken Stones, any excess points beyond what's needed for creation will not accumulate and will be deleted. 　ex) If you use 2,100 points as shown below, 1 Awaken Stones will be crafted and the excess 100 points will be deleted.

【Core Awakening】

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/9049ee00cc78426d645caa9fe03eb66790beca30.png"]

You can awaken core stats using Awaken Stones in the \[Core Management - Awaken] tab.

You can awaken core options using 30 Awaken Stones.

You can input quantities of 30/60/90/120 in the usage field, allowing multiple Awakening at once.

notes.title: Preview: Tree of Savior Zachariel Release and Integration of Region
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/b2b0588317b3671e1cca98ab778b98a37dd12f9e.png"]

Greetings, Saviors.





To bring new encounters and expanded adventures to Tree of Savior, the current servers: NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute will be merged into a single server named ‘Zachariel’ on Tuesday, July 15, 2025 (KST).



The new Zachariel server will unite Saviors from various regions, forming a diverse community that transcends language and culture. We believe this significant change will inject vitality into the game, fostering more dynamic strategies and collaboration in an enriched gameplay environment.



Saviors from your favorite guilds and regions will be able to find new goals to work towards, while those who aren't tied to a guild or region will be able to create their own unique groupings.



No new installations or changes are required to access Zachariel Server. Simply launch the Tree of Savior client through Steam as usual, and you will automatically connect to the merged server.



⚠️In the meanwhile, SA Silute TP Product Sales will be restricted due to this Server Merge⚠️ 


TP product sales in the SA server will be temporarily restricted starting from the date of this announcement. This is due to price standardization to align with NA/EU server pricing.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/e9da67cc957c47d01f4acb21366bbe80fb40df74.png"]



To celebrate the launch of Zachariel, we have prepared a variety of exciting events for all Saviors.

In particular, special rewards will be awarded for the first Guild Territory War after the integration.



The first Guild Territory Wars (GTW) held in the Zachariel server will offer special rewards. Guilds that occupy the Champion League regions —  'Genar Field', 'Aqueduct Bridge Area', and 'Baron Allerno'— will receive a commemorative guild flag engraved with a text and image of the guild’s choice. 

Additionally, amazing login rewards will be distributed to all players who log into the Zachariel server within the first 7 days after the merge.


             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/1360aa9a9ac015adf9539495a7629c00671584a1.png"]                 

We’ve also prepared refreshing summer events and adorable new mounts to accompany your journey. We look forward to seeing your exciting adventures unfold in the new Zachariel server.

notes.title: Invite Your Friends Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

The fruit leaves behind seeds, which in turn grows into a fruit, and the cycle continues! Invite your Friends to Tree of Savior and receive the rewards!

Event Period

From: After the scheduled maintenance on April 15, 2025 (KST)
To: Before the scheduled maintenance on May 27, 2025 (KST)

Step 1. Check if you are a Fruit or a Seed!

- Click the envelop icon below the Popo Boost icon to participate in the Invite Your Friends event. Both icons can be found on the top right corner, to the lower left of the minimap.

- By clicking the Issue/Retrieve Invite Code, you can check whether you are a Fruit or a Seed, and enter the Invite Code!

▶ Fruit (Referrer/Inviter)

- You can share the Invite Code to a Seed.

- One code can invite a single Seed and can not be reused.

- In order to check your Invite Code, you must have at least one character that have reached maximum character level of 530.

▶ Seed (Referee/Invitee)

- Seeds are Saviors without a log-in record before March 16, 2025 (KST)

- You can enter the Invite Code shared from the Fruit and clear the Invite Your Friends event missions.

- You can only enter a single code and once entered, it cannot be edited or changed.

Step 2. Complete the Invite Your Friends mission and receive the reward!

- By clicking the Check Invite Your Friends Mission/Receive Rewards or by entering /invite command, you can check the event status. 

- Only the Seed can click the [Receive Rewards] button, but the reward will be given to both the Fruit and the Seed once clicked.

- The Reward will be given to the following locations:

▶ Fruit: Mailbox (please make sure to claim it before June 11, 2025.) 

▶ Seed: Inventory

Important Note


The UI and the icon of this event will become unavailable after the scheduled maintenance on May 27, 2024 (KST).
A code can invite a single Seed, and the code cannot be reused.
You can only enter a single code and once entered, it cannot be changed.

notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/640088c9f36c781f67fcb67176006f68fa30c68c.jpg

Greetings, Saviors!

A warm breeze carries the sweet scent of cherry blossoms! Celebrate spring’s beauty at the Cherry Blossom Festival!

Event Period

After the regular scheduled maintence on March 11, 2025
TO April 15, 2025 (KST), before the regular scheduled maintenance

How to Participate

Step 1. [Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC will be available during the event period.
- The NPCs are present at [Klaipeda], [Orsha], and [Fedimian].
- Their specific locations are marked as a red dot in the image below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/4fcadfbffbfc2f7647c6143dabe5d43903997599.png

Step 2. Clear Challenge/Raid contents and/or defeat field monsters to receive [Event] TOS Platinum Coin!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/4eae4a08ffb9ce2f97b7ccc92e5a6a3df224f09c.png

* Only monsters with level difference of 50 or less will drop [Event] TOS Platinum Coins.

- Example 1: If your character is level 530, only monsters of level 480 or above will have 5% chance of dropping [Event] TOS Platinum Coins.
- Example 2: If your character is level 480, only monsters in the level range of 430 ~ 530 will have 5% chance of dropping [Event] TOS Platinum Coins.

Step 3. Exchange the [Event] TOS Platinum Coins for various rewards from the Event Shop!
※ You can type "/event" without the quotations to check your current coin status (e.g. weekly limit, total limit, and vice versa)

- Head to the [Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC that can be found in each town and talk to the NPC to exchange the [Event] TOS Platinum Coins with the items below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/a8788c8c1b0c7c298ad04a27863e45d4682fd8e7.png

* Pink Cherry Blossom item details:
- Item lasts for 1 Day.

Grants a buff on use:
- Final DMG +3%, Restores 150 HP/SP every 2 sec, MSPD +4
- The buff lasts for 24 hours.

Disclaimer

- Up to 600 [Event] TOS Platinum Coins can be obtained per week, per team.
- Up to 3,000 [Event] TOS Platinum Coins can be obtained in total, during the event period.
- The weekly limit of [Event] TOS Platinum Coins resets on each Monday, 6 AM (server time).
- [Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC will be available until April 15, 2025, before the maintenance.

notes.title: Help us reduce issues with claiming TP Bundles!
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors,

We would like to announce that we will be offering 20% additional TP as compensation for any players who may have issues with claiming their TP Bundle purchases made from now until April 30th. 

We wish to use this chance as a way to apologize for the continued issues with regards to the TP claiming process and to show our willingness to solve these issues. There has been a lot of tinkering behind the scenes to smoothen out the process, but we admit that it can always be better. 

Please carefully read the details below to see how you can help us improve our TP distribution process as well as gain additional TP in the process. If you require any help on how to claim your TP Bundles, make sure to check out our guide here.

The following list shows how much TP you will be compensated with if you have an issue with a certain TP Bundle product.

- Per 100 TP Bundle (100 TP) : Compensation of 20 TP

- Per 300 TP Bundle (310 TP) : Compensation of 70 TP

- Per 500 TP Bundle (530 TP) : Compensation of 110 TP

- Per 900 TP Bundle (990 TP) : Compensation of 200 TP

IMPORTANT : Please read the following conditions to see if you are applicable for compensation.

1-1. You must have either pressed the 'USE' button OR used the '/retrieveAllItems' command in order to start the TP claiming process.

1-2. Any attempts at claiming TP Bundles not meant for your server region will not be counted.

2. A minimum of 24 hours must have passed after the initial start of the TP claiming process (Condition 1-1).

3. You must send us a Ticket via the Support Page when the issue arises.

4. Any attempts at abusing the system may result in you becoming inapplicable for compensation.

 
Thank you as always for the continued love, support, and attention.
 

Best regards,

IMC Staff

notes.title: [Guild Delete Exploit] Now Accepting Guild Restore Requests
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We recently fixed an exploit in the game that allowed players to disband their guilds without becoming the guild master (more details here). As a result, several guilds have reportedly been deleted unintentionally.

We are planning to restore all guilds disbanded through this exploit during our next scheduled maintenance on May 24, 2016, and will now start accepting requests via Support ticket.

Guild masters of guilds affected by the exploit may send in their requests via Support ticket (Type: Etc) until [EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM.

Before you send in your request, make sure you read and understand the conditions below:

- Only guild masters may submit a restore request for their guild
- Requests must be submitted via Support ticket (Type: Etc)
- We will accept requests submitted until [EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM

How to submit your request via Support ticket (only submit if you are the guild master):

1) Go to the Support Page on our official website
2) If you haven't, verify your Steam account
3) Click on Submit Ticket
4) Select Type: Etc, then enter your information on the fields shown
5) Enter the following in Title: -GUILD RESTORE- YOUR GUILD NAME
6) In Description, enter the following information
   - Server:
   - Guild name:
   - Guild master character's name:
   - Approx. date and time guild was deleted (EDT):

Let us know if you run into trouble when submitting your request.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Known Issues [UPDATED - April 12th]
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We are aware of the problems some of you are experiencing while trying to log into the game. For the following known issues, please try the solutions we suggest. Head to our official forums for the xml files in question. 

Link to post in official forums : https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/known-issues-march-29th/157442

1. Server List Not Showing on Log-In Screen

Please download the files from the official forums and copy and paste them to the following directories.

client.xml -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release

updater.config.xml  -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch

updater.config_en.xml 
-> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch


2. $No Data$ texts in-game

For players that see $No Data$ texts in-game instead of normal text, please try the following.

a) Go to Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release
b) Open release.revision.txt
c) Erase the number that is typed in the file
d) Save the file and close it
e) Restart the game

3. Unable to advance in class

We are aware that some of you are experiencing problems when trying to advance in class. The dev team is looking into it and an announcement will be made when this issue is resolved.

4. Controller issues
Playstation 3, Playstation 4 and Xbox 360 controllers should be working correctly. However, we are aware that Xbox One controllers may have issues and are working on a fix. Please note that having controllers plugged in may conflict with mouse input .

Possible fix for Xbox One Controllers : Replacing the Xinput driver from the KB3140743 update with a previous version of the driver should fix the problem. (Thank you to the user that brought this to our attention)

5. Server bottleneck issues
The server bottleneck problem seems to be much worse than expected. We are currently looking into several options to mitigate the problem, including creating a new server. We have not yet reached a final decision on the details and will let you know as soon as possible.

6. Spamming on chat
You will be able to reset the chat and get rid of spamming of messages in chat by restarting your client. Please let us know if the problems persists after restarting the client. We are looking at ways to reduce spam and will make an announcement when it is implemented.

7. QUEST : To Gateway to the Great King
We are aware that there are issues with this quest and are working on a solution. Apologies for the inconvenience that this is causing. In the meantime, we recommend trying to go to Orsha and completing quests in that area for those players that find no other quests for that level.

8. Launcher closes without client properly appearing
There seems to be a problem with the launcher vanishing without properly launching the client even after validating / re-installing / replacing XML files. The dev team is looking into this matter, but in the meantime, adding "Client_tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release" and "tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release\patch" to the exception list of any Anti-virus programs may help.

9. QUEST :  Obversion / Drowsy Scent
We are aware that these quests currently have people stumped. We will be working on a more permanent fix. Please stay tuned for an update regarding these quests. In the meantime, we would recommend trying other zones / questlines.

Unfinished Commision should now work properly. However, please let us know via the ticket system if you are still having trouble with this particular quest.

10. Instance disconnect problems / Malfunctioning elevators & cable cars
This is do to connection problems with the channel. You should be able to connect to the channel if you choose one with less people. The dev team will be looking into the issue to make it more stable. 

11. Disabling Shout Chat on top of the screen
We are working on a more permanent fix, but at the moment you may disable the banners at the top of your screen to avoid spam by unwanted individuals. Please go to the small gear icon next to your chat window and uncheck the 'Show Shouts on Top' function to disable shout chat.

12. Steam must be running to play this game. SteamAPInitfailed
This error may occur if you attempt to run the game directly from the desktop. We recommend that you log onto the Steam client and run the game from your library.

13. Zubeck's Secret Moves Item
This item gives you 1 stat point upon use. There's a bug where if you use it while in a dungeon, the item gets consumed, but you don't receive your stat point. We're going to look into this issue and find a way to compensate those who did not get their stat point from this item.

14. Cannot patch game / launch game after patch
We are aware that some players are experiencing problems patching and launching the game at the moment. We are looking into the issue, but in the meantime here is the workaround. Apologies for the inconvenience.

 - Go to Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release
 - Open the release.revision.txt file and edit the number to 11460
 - Validate local files through Steam and check to see if the language is set to English.


Please let us know if you are experiencing other problems. When reporting issues, please try to be as detailed as possible so that we can have more information to use in resolving those issues.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Fedimian Server and Consolatory Notice [UPDATED]
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

Thank you for your patience throughout our launch for the past few hours.

We are here to bring you news that our new Femidian server is ready to be opened within the next hour.

Please keep in mind that this is a temporary EU server meant to accommodate players who wish to be transferred to our upcoming server in Europe.

When we open the Femidian server, we will let you know through a new post announcing its release.

Related announcement: https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/temporary-eu-server-in-preparation/157179/


In addition, we would like to make an important announcement regarding the number of players accessing our Exclusive Access servers.

Prior to the announcement, please accept our apologies for rather crowded servers with high traffics.

We had initially planned 2 servers based on our sales data. They were sufficient enough to support the player base without waiting queues.

However, there was an unexpected jump in sales a day prior to our scheduled launch date. There was an additional influx of sales, the amount exceeding well over a third of our most recent total sales, and the statistics were not observed in time due to the data refresh being queued.

As a result, our players experienced heavy lags and connection issues, which is what we previously stated that we would prevent.

In order to make up for the inconvenience we have caused you on the first day of our grand opening due to our inability to foresee this event, we would like to provide you with compensation. We will make a separate announcement later regarding the details.

A great number of mistakes have already been made, but we hope to learn from this and deliver you a stable service and an enjoyable game. We would greatly appreciate your support in this endeavor. Thank you.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

[UPDATE - March 29th]
We would like to announce the consolatory items that will be provided via the in-game message box. Please refer to the list below for details. 

- Enchant Scroll x 5
- EXP Tome x 5
- Lv 15 Movement Speed Potion x 20

The items will expire on 11:59 p.m. (EDT) on the 4th of April, 2016 so make sure you claim the items before that time.

notes.title: Founder's Server : Exclusive Access Now Purchasable on Steam
notes.content:
Hello, Saviors!

This is an announcement to let you know that the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access is available for purchase on Steam.

Please note the following
1. Service Schedule
 - Founder's Server Open Date : Tuesday, March 29, 2016 02:00 AM (EST)
 - Free to Play Server Open Date : Thursday, April 28, 2016 (EST)

 2. Purchasing the Founder's Server : Exclusive Access does not directly allow access to the founder's server.

1.The items will be sent to your in-game message box via GM message that will be accessible after Team creation. You may choose which character you wish to give the items to from the GM message.

3.There will be no time limit on when you can redeem your items. You may decide to receive them at the time of your choice.

5.The Hanaming and Popolion Doll Hair Accessories cannot be obtained in-game. They may be obtainable in the future through other products or events.


6.The Stat Reset Potion cannot be obtained in-game, while the Skill Reset Potion can be purchased from the TP shop.


7.Token benefits cannot be paused / restarted once the Token is used. Please make sure you wish to receive the benefits before using Tokens.


8.A maximum of 3 options can be enchanted on the Hair Accessories by purchasing "Magic Scrolls" from the TP shop.


9.TP obtained from the passes can be used to purchase premium items from the TP shops in the cities.


Best regards,
IMC Staff
